releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.23:
- English Default Standard: Displays & Kiosks setup modal and Hardware settings updated to 100% clean English by default, with dynamic Spanish translation active only when explicitly enabled by user settings.
- Default English Station Installers: Single station USB export and direct downloads default to English out of the box with optional Spanish toggle.
- Clean Modal Structure: Verified HTML tag balance and 100% modal integrity across all 72 modal dialogs with zero warnings.
